entities.summary: Francis Serrao, S.J. is an Indian prelate of the Catholic Church who has served as the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Shimoga since 2014. In August 2025, he was named bishop of Mysore. He was installed in a ceremony in October 2025.
